preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The total number of squares n * m must be at least 2.

postconditions.description: The number of teleporters k must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= m and 1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y2 <= m for x1, y1, x2, y2 in teleporters)
postconditions.description: Each teleporter must be installed and lead to a square within the field boundaries.
The path must contain exactly nm + 1 squares.
The path must start and end at the capital (1, 1).
The path must visit each square except the capital exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all((path[i][0] == path[i+1][0] and abs(path[i][1] - path[i+1][1]) == 1) or (path[i][1] == path[i+1][1] and abs(path[i][0] - path[i+1][0]) == 1) or (path[i] in [t[0] for t in teleporters] and path[i+1] == [t[1] for t in teleporters][[t[0] for t in teleporters].index(path[i])]) for i in range(len(path) - 1))
postconditions.description: Each move in the path must be to a side-neighboring square or via a teleporter.
